That definition requires only containment and permits, for example, the valid rational output \( [\lfloor x-r\rfloor-1,\lceil x+r\rceil+1]\), whose excess width does not vanish. A root-\(n\) local diameter requires an additional rounding-excess condition or a precision schedule, neither of which is declared. The proposed claim removes only that unsupported ancillary rate clause.

narrow: The original compatibility biconditional omitted the stability and positive-innovation checks required by the compatible-fiber definition. The recursive uniqueness claim is unchanged, but sufficiency is true only when those checks are included.

The corrected theorem excludes the zero-diagonal nonregular root map, declares the query-edge condition needed for nondegenerate exact nominal bands, and wires in the proved uniform lag-moment Gaussian limit.

narrow: The frozen regular class permits a zero diagonal persistence. For odd subsampling the inverse diagonal map then has an unbounded derivative and generally has a non-root-n, non-Gaussian limit. Uniform Wald inference therefore requires separation of the diagonal root derivative. A nonempty frequency grid and an allowed queried edge are also required for exact, rather than conservative or degenerate, nominal coverage.

narrow: At an empty compatible fiber, universal equality of all transfer elements is vacuous, while the mandated output is incompatibility. Conditioning the singleton-transfer clause on nonemptiness makes the three output cases disjoint and logically exact.
